definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of arranging flowers, emphasizing form, balance, and harmony.

examples.japanese: {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: To display a flower arrangement in the entrance.

examples.japanese: {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an ikebana exhibition.

notes:
{生|い}け{花|ばな} is the Japanese art of flower arrangement, one of the traditional arts alongside ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony) and ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ (calligraphy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn ikebana
- {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display a flower arrangement
- {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: ikebana teacher
- {生|い}け{花|ばな}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: ikebana class

MAJOR SCHOOLS:
- ⟦{池坊|いけのぼう}→池坊：noentry⟧: the oldest school (over 500 years)
- ⟦{草月流|そうげつりゅう}→草月流：noentry⟧: modern, avant-garde style
- ⟦{小原流|おはらりゅう}→小原流：noentry⟧: naturalistic style

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ is a more formal name for the art. ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ emphasizes it as a "way" or discipline (⟦{道|どう}→道：noentry⟧), while {生|い}け{花|ばな} is the more common everyday term.
